page.metadataDescription.source: Prepare a private evidence request, compare signed provider quotations, and review exact supplied excerpts under a bounded quote budget.
page.metadataDescription.text: 准备私密证据请求，在有界报价预算内比较已签名提供方报价并审阅确切提供的摘录。

page.kicker.text: 私密证据采购 · 提议工作区

page.heading.source: When the evidence you need is missing

page.introduction.source: Turn a gap in your research into a bounded request for new evidence.
page.introduction.text: 将研究缺口转化为获取新证据的有界请求。

page.noScript.source: JavaScript is required for this tab-memory workspace. No request is submitted on this page.
page.noScript.text: 此标签页内存工作区需要 JavaScript。此页面不会提交请求。

workspace.prepareAnEvidenceRequestCompar.source: Prepare an evidence request, compare provider quotations, and inspect the exact evidence supplied for your decision.
workspace.prepareAnEvidenceRequestCompar.text: 准备证据请求、比较提供方报价，并检查用于决策的确切提供证据。

workspace.workStaysInThisTabSMemoryAndIs.source: Work stays in this tab's memory and is lost on reload. Exports are private plaintext files: they contain your question, provider details and supplied text.
workspace.workStaysInThisTabSMemoryAndIs.text: 工作保留在此标签页内存中，重新加载会丢失。导出是私密明文文件，包含问题、提供方详情和提供的文本。

workspace.nameADecisionAndTheMissingFact.source: Name a decision and the missing facts that could change it. Priority is your declaration, from 1 to 10.
workspace.nameADecisionAndTheMissingFact.text: 说明决策及可能改变决策的缺失事实。优先级由您声明，范围为 1 至 10。

workspace.arcTestnetQuotationOnly.text: Arc 测试网 — 仅报价

workspace.whatDecisionAreYouTryingToMake.source: What decision are you trying to make?

workspace.replacingTheRequestClearsAllQu.source: Replacing the request clears all quotations, deliveries, selections and reviews, because their signatures bind the original request.
workspace.replacingTheRequestClearsAllQu.text: 替换请求会清除所有报价、交付、选择和审阅，因为其签名绑定原始请求。

workspace.aProviderPromisesADeliverableA.source: A provider promises a deliverable and coverage. A valid provider signature authenticates that promise; it does not prove ownership of the linked source.
workspace.aProviderPromisesADeliverableA.text: 提供方承诺交付内容和覆盖范围。有效提供方签名认证此承诺；不证明其拥有链接来源。

workspace.providerNonceUniqueForThisWall.text: 提供方 nonce（此钱包内唯一）

workspace.requirementsTheProviderPromise.source: Requirements the provider promises to address
workspace.requirementsTheProviderPromise.text: 提供方承诺回应的要求

workspace.importAProviderSOfferJSONInste.source: Import a provider's offer JSON instead
workspace.importAProviderSOfferJSONInste.text: 改为导入提供方报价 JSON

workspace.noQuotationsYetAddOneAboveOrIm.source: No quotations yet. Add one above or import a signed provider offer.
workspace.noQuotationsYetAddOneAboveOrIm.text: 尚无报价。在上方添加，或导入已签名提供方报价。

workspace.compareToInspectSignaturesRema.source: Compare to inspect signatures, remaining budget and the next recommendation.
workspace.compareToInspectSignaturesRema.text: 通过比较检查签名、剩余预算和下一项建议。

workspace.recommendedNextHighestDeclared.source: Recommended next: highest declared missing priority per micro-USDC. This compares promises, not delivered quality.
workspace.recommendedNextHighestDeclared.text: 下一项建议：每 micro-USDC 对应的已声明缺失优先级最高者。这比较的是承诺，不是交付质量。

workspace.paymentNotObservedNoFundsReser.source: Payment: not observed. No funds reserved or spent.
workspace.paymentNotObservedNoFundsReser.text: 付款：未观察到。没有资金预留或支出。

workspace.pasteSuppliedTextHighlightAnEx.source: Paste supplied text, highlight an exact passage, then attach its provider-declared stance to a requirement. Changing the text clears its excerpts and signature.
workspace.pasteSuppliedTextHighlightAnEx.text: 粘贴所提供文本，突出显示确切段落，然后将提供方声明的立场附到要求上。更改文本会清除摘录和签名。

workspace.requirementForHighlightedPassa.text: 突出显示段落对应的要求

workspace.importAProviderSDeliveryJSONIn.source: Import a provider's delivery JSON instead
workspace.importAProviderSDeliveryJSONIn.text: 改为导入提供方交付 JSON

workspace.readEachExactExcerptYouMayDecl.source: Read each exact excerpt. You may declare a supporting or refuting passage useful to your decision. This is your review, not independent truth validation, customer acceptance or payment authority.
workspace.readEachExactExcerptYouMayDecl.text: 阅读每条确切摘录。您可声明支持或反驳段落对决策有用。这是您的审阅，不是独立真相验证、客户验收或付款授权。

workspace.compareTheCurrentPacketToInspe.source: Compare the current packet to inspect and review deliveries.
workspace.compareTheCurrentPacketToInspe.text: 比较当前数据包以检查和审阅交付。

workspace.privatePacketExportAndRestore.text: 私密数据包导出与恢复

workspace.downloadThePacketToContinueLat.source: Download the packet to continue later or share selected private fields deliberately. Only the packet can be restored; a decision receipt is a dated inspection result.
workspace.downloadThePacketToContinueLat.text: 下载数据包以稍后继续，或有意共享所选私密字段。只有数据包可恢复；决策凭证是注明日期的检查结果。

workspace.restorePrivatePacketFileJSONUp.source: Restore private packet file (JSON, up to 64 KiB)
workspace.restorePrivatePacketFileJSONUp.text: 恢复私密数据包文件（JSON，最多 64 KiB）

workspace.replaceTabWithValidatedPacket.text: 使用已验证数据包替换标签页

messages.amountFormat.source: Use a USDC amount with at most six decimal places.
messages.amountFormat.text: 使用最多六位小数的 USDC 金额。

messages.validationFailed.source: Could not validate this change. Check the bounded fields, identifiers, signatures and exact excerpt positions. Your packet has been kept.
messages.validationFailed.text: 无法验证此更改。请检查有界字段、标识符、签名和确切摘录位置。数据包已保留。

messages.selectionRemoved.source: Proposal selection removed. Compare again to inspect the remaining quotations.
messages.selectionRemoved.text: 提议选择已移除。再次比较以检查剩余报价。

messages.selectionRefused.source: Quotation cannot be selected now. It expired or no longer adds eligible coverage. Compare again.
messages.selectionRefused.text: 现在无法选择此报价。它已过期或不再补充符合条件的覆盖。请再次比较。

messages.selectionChanged.source: Proposal selection changed. Compare again before selecting another quotation.
messages.selectionChanged.text: 提议选择发生变化。选择其他报价前请再次比较。

messages.restoreValidated.source: Packet validated. Inspect the summary before replacing this tab's work.
messages.restoreValidated.text: 数据包已验证。替换此标签页工作前请检查摘要。

messages.restoreRefused.source: Unsupported or invalid packet. Existing work has been kept.
messages.restoreRefused.text: 不支持或无效的数据包。现有工作已保留。

messages.offerSignatureAdded.source: Matching unsigned quotation upgraded with its provider signature. Compare to verify it.
messages.offerSignatureAdded.text: 匹配的未签名报价已补充提供方签名。请通过比较验证。

messages.offerAdded.source: Quotation added. Compare to verify its signature and proposed coverage.
messages.offerAdded.text: 报价已添加。请通过比较验证签名和提议覆盖。

messages.deliverySignatureAdded.source: Matching unsigned delivery upgraded with its provider signature. Compare to authenticate its bytes.
messages.deliverySignatureAdded.text: 匹配的未签名交付已补充提供方签名。请通过比较认证字节。

messages.deliveryAdded.source: Delivery added. Compare to authenticate supplied bytes before recording a review.
messages.deliveryAdded.text: 交付已添加。记录审阅前请通过比较认证所提供字节。

messages.providerDataDownloaded.source: Private provider fields downloaded. The provider must sign the matching canonical message; importing a signature authenticates no payment.
messages.providerDataDownloaded.text: 私密提供方字段已下载。提供方必须签署匹配的规范消息；导入签名不认证任何付款。

messages.signingMessageDownloaded.source: Downloaded the exact signing message. This message authorizes no payment. Keep its matching unsigned packet fields unchanged.
messages.signingMessageDownloaded.text: 确切签名消息已下载。此消息不授权任何付款。请保持匹配的未签名数据包字段不变。

messages.messageSigned.source: Provider message signed. Add it to the packet, then compare to verify the signature.
messages.messageSigned.text: 提供方消息已签名。将其添加到数据包，再通过比较验证签名。

messages.messageRefused.source: Message was not signed. Use the provider's matching wallet and unchanged fields.
messages.messageRefused.text: 消息未签名。使用提供方匹配的钱包和未更改字段。

messages.restored.source: Restored the validated private packet. Compare again to inspect current expiry and signatures.
messages.restored.text: 已恢复经验证的私密数据包。再次比较以检查当前有效期和签名。

messages.requestPrepared.source: Request prepared. Export it for providers or add a quotation below.
messages.requestPrepared.text: 请求已准备。导出给提供方，或在下方添加报价。

messages.compared.source: Comparison recomputed from the current packet. Selection remains a proposal only.
messages.compared.text: 已根据当前数据包重新计算比较结果。选择仍仅为提议。

messages.offerRemoved.source: Quotation and its dependent delivery/review removed.
messages.offerRemoved.text: 报价及依赖它的交付和审阅已移除。

messages.selectExcerpt.source: Highlight an exact passage in the supplied delivery text first.
messages.selectExcerpt.text: 先在提供的交付文本中突出显示确切段落。

messages.reviewRecorded.source: Caller review recorded. Compare again to build an updated decision receipt.
messages.reviewRecorded.text: 调用者审阅已记录。再次比较以生成更新的决策凭证。

messages.deliveryRemoved.source: Delivery and its dependent review removed.
messages.deliveryRemoved.text: 交付及依赖它的审阅已移除。

messages.packetDownloaded.source: Private plaintext packet downloaded. Store it securely; this tab has no persistent save.
messages.packetDownloaded.text: 私密明文数据包已下载。请安全保存；此标签页没有持久保存。

messages.receiptDownloaded.source: Private plaintext decision receipt downloaded. Its caller reviews and unobserved payment status remain explicit.
messages.receiptDownloaded.text: 私密明文决策凭证已下载。其中明确保留调用者审阅和未观察到付款的状态。

messages.cleared.source: Packet and private form text cleared from this tab. Downloaded files are unchanged.
messages.cleared.text: 数据包和私密表单文本已从此标签页清除。下载文件保持不变。

messages.fileTooLarge.source: Packet file exceeds the supported limit. Existing work has been kept.
messages.fileTooLarge.text: 数据包文件超过支持上限。现有工作已保留。

messages.fileReadFailed.source: Could not read this packet file. Existing work has been kept.
messages.fileReadFailed.text: 无法读取此数据包文件。现有工作已保留。

messages.restoreCancelled.source: Restore cancelled. Existing work has been kept.
messages.restoreCancelled.text: 恢复已取消。现有工作已保留。

reasons.eligible.source: Signed quotation eligible for this proposal
reasons.eligible.text: 已签名报价符合此提议条件

reasons.unsigned-offer.text: 未签名报价 — 提供方身份未验证

reasons.invalid-offer-signature.source: Offer signature does not authenticate this quotation
reasons.invalid-offer-signature.text: 报价签名不能认证此报价

reasons.no-new-proposed-coverage.source: Adds no currently missing proposed coverage
reasons.no-new-proposed-coverage.text: 未补充当前缺失的提议覆盖

reasons.different-request.source: Quotation is bound to another request

reasons.attributed-bytes.source: Signature authenticates these exact supplied bytes
reasons.attributed-bytes.text: 签名认证这些确切的所提供字节

reasons.unsigned-delivery.text: 未签名交付 — 暂不进入审阅

reasons.body-hash-mismatch.text: 交付文本在计算哈希后发生变化

reasons.invalid-excerpt.source: Excerpt does not bind an exact usable slice
reasons.invalid-excerpt.text: 摘录未绑定确切的可用片段

reasons.different-offer.source: Delivery is bound to another quotation

reasons.caller-reviewed.text: 调用者审阅已记录 — 属于声明

reasons.unbound-review.source: Review is not bound to an authenticated delivery
reasons.unbound-review.text: 审阅未绑定已认证交付

templates.requestSummary.text: 报价上限 {amount} · {network} · 于 {expiresAt} 到期

templates.coverage.text: 提议覆盖：{requirements} · 于 {expiresAt} 到期

templates.budgetSummary.text: 计划报价总额：{planned} · 剩余：{remaining}

templates.missingRequirements.source: Still missing according to caller review: {requirements}
templates.missingRequirements.text: 根据调用者审阅仍缺失：{requirements}

templates.reviewExcerpt.text: {requirement} · 提供方声明 {stance} · 确切提供片段

templates.reviewDeclaration.text: 我已审阅 {requirement}，认为是有用的 {stance} 证据

templates.restoreHeading.text: 使用请求 {id} 替换此标签页：{decision}

templates.restoreSummary.source: {offers} quotations · {deliveries} deliveries · {reviews} caller reviews · quote cap {amount}
templates.restoreSummary.text: {offers} 个报价 · {deliveries} 个交付 · {reviews} 项调用者审阅 · 报价上限 {amount}
